annotation.title_clean: Future Intelligent Autonomous Robots, Ethical by Design – Lessons Learned from Autonomous Cars Ethics
annotation.title_en: Future Intelligent Autonomous Robots, Ethical by Design – Lessons Learned from Autonomous Cars Ethics
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Dodig-Crnkovic, G.; Holstein, T.; Pelliccione, P.; Thavarasa, J.
annotation.venue: Proceedings of the 14th International Conference on Society and Information Technologies (ICSIT 2023)
annotation.summary_en: Conference paper proposing an "ethical by design" approach for intelligent autonomous robots, drawing on autonomous car ethics. It proposes a set of values and principles (safety, privacy, transparency, accountability, fairness, human control, sustainability) and argues for context-sensitive application and continuous development of principles, guidelines and regulation.
key_provisions_or_claims: Ethical by design examines all lifecycle stages for ethical justifiability and social sustainability.
Proposes principles: safety, security, privacy, transparency, explainability, accountability, fairness, human control, well-being, autonomy, sustainability.
Autonomous car ethics largely transfers to all AI-powered robots, with domain-specific additions.
Ethical frameworks need context-sensitive application via interdisciplinary multi-criteria assessment.
Calls for continuous development of principles, guidelines and regulations with stakeholder involvement.
